lines.text: As far as the east is from the west,
so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
As a father has compassion on his children,
so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
He is mindful that we are dust.
As for man, his days are like grass—
he blooms like a flower of the field;
when the wind passes over, it vanishes,
and its place remembers it no more.
the loving devotion of the LORD
extends to those who fear Him,
and His righteousness to their children’s children—
to those who keep His covenant
and remember to obey His precepts.

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, Crucifixion — Christ alone on the cross against the darkness with His arms stretched wide, as far as the east is from the west
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_oosten

pictures.scene: Bartolomé Esteban Murillo, The Holy Family with a Little Bird — Joseph seated with the child on his knee and his hand steadying him, as a father has compassion on his children
pictures.name: pd_murillo_vader

pictures.scene: Jusepe de Ribera, The Clubfoot — the crippled boy smiling with his crutch on his shoulder and his paper asking alms for the love of God, for He knows our frame
pictures.name: pd_ribera_maaksel

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Wheatfield with Crows — the wheat bending under a storm-blue sky with the crows going over, as for man his days are like grass
pictures.name: pd_gogh_stof

pictures.scene: Jan van Huysum, Vase of Flowers — crown imperial and poppy and roses open at their fullest for one morning, he blooms like a flower of the field
pictures.name: pd_huysum_bloem

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Winter Landscape with Church — the crutches thrown down in the snow and the man at the crucifix with the cathedral rising out of the mist, and its place remembers it no more but from everlasting to everlasting
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_plaats

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Supper at Emmaus — Christ's hand out over the bread in blessing at the table, the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_goedheid

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, The Last Supper — Christ raising His hand over the bread with the twelve around the table, to those who keep His covenant
pictures.name: pd_bouts_verbond

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Holy Trinity — the Father holding the Son with the dove above them and the angels all around, the LORD has established His throne in heaven
pictures.name: pd_greco_troon
